title: Mean-value inequality from pointwise upper Lipschitz bounds on [0,1]
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, γ : ℝ → ℝ^N (ℝ^N = Eucl N with the Euclidean norm) and K ∈ ℝ. Suppose that for every s ∈ [0,1] and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that ‖γ(s′) − γ(s)‖ ≤ (K + ε)|s′ − s| for all s′ ∈ [0,1] with |s′ − s| < δ. Then ‖γ(1) − γ(0)‖ ≤ K.
